title: Delegating to the Machine: replication package (code, pre-analysis plan, results and paper)
description: Code, pre-analysis plan (frozen as git tag pap-v1), results, robustness and red-team records, and the paper and brief for Delegating to the Machine: How People Hand Work to AI, and Whether Equity Markets Priced It. The raw data are not in this record: they are deposited as two separate Zenodo datasets (a public part, and a restricted part holding the Kenneth R. French Data Library and AIOE files, whose sources state no licence, available on request), built by `uv run python -m aideleg.acquire --build-deposit OUT`. Code is MIT-licensed; text, results and figures are CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-text.md). See README.md.
